title: The Drowned Hoard
text: A strongbox sits at the bottom of a clear pool, its hinges green, its lid bulging. Too heavy for one to lift, easy for all of you together. The Houses agree to split it. Each decides alone, staring down at it in the night, whether they mean to.

options.label: Split it fairly, as you agreed.

outcomes.text: Everyone is honest. The box comes up, the lid opens and the shares are good.
Your share is gone before you reach it. The water is muddy with someone's haste.

options.label: Dive early in the night, and take the lot for your House.

outcomes.text: Nobody else thought of it. You come up heavy, grinning and very cold.
Others had the same idea. Knives flash under the dark water, and nobody wins.
